notes.title: Announcing an Orange Juice Board Game!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5795599/1007b09870ce021e360b0314d1f3a2b72cb259cf.png[/img][/url]
Ever found yourself hoping for an Orange Juice-themed physical board game? Your wish has been heard!

We're most excited to announce a collaboration with [b]Level 99 Games[/b] to bring you [b]Bullet🍊[/b], an expansion to the fast-paced 1-4 player bullet hell-themed [b]Bullet♥︎[/b], featuring [b]Suguri, Sora, QP and Marc[/b] as new heroines!

[b]Bullet🍊[/b] is [url=https://www.level99store.com/pages/bullet-orange]now available for pre-order[/url], and all pre-orders will give you a bonus [b]Acceleration of SUGURI 2 Steam key[/b] as well!

Do note that this expansion requires [b]Bullet♥︎[/b] to play (sold separately).

You can also try the game and new expansion in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2100600905]official Tabletop Simulator version[/url] to get a feel for it!

notes.title: Xmas Shooting - Scramble!! Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7057675/2b9f9734b85a1a760b3fbf11e79d6925befab34c.jpg[/img]
QP Shooting's cousin, Xmas Shooting - Scramble!! is now available on Steam!

Orange Juice's latest cute'em'up, Xmas Shooting - Scramble!! is a prequel to QP Shooting - Dangerous!! and tells the story of Aru, everyone's favorite bunny-eared Santa (and QP's shopkeeper) saving Christmas.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/560050
Everyone who has played QP Shooting - Dangerous!! will be right at home in the 3 challenging stages of Xmas Shooting - Scramble!!

notes.title: Extra Dangerous Bonus Character
notes.content:
[img]https://fruitbatfactory.files.wordpress.com/2014/11/qpd-unlock.png[/img]
We are happy to announce that a very special, fan-requested bonus is coming for QP Shooting – Dangerous!!.

All owners of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/316600]QP Shooting – Dangerous!![/url] will unlock a free bonus character in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/282800]100% Orange Juice[/url] on Steam.

QP (Dangerous version) is an original character designed by Orange_Juice, with art by Hono. She’s a re-imagining of QP as she appears in her signature game QP Shooting – Dangerous!!, with new abilities and a hyper card. Can anyone resist her energetic cuteness?

As we are excited to make another great game by Orange_Juice available to gamers worldwide, we felt this was a great opportunity to connect the games of the popular franchise more closely. The new character is prepared in cooperation with Orange_Juice, exclusively for the game’s Steam release.

QP (Dangerous) will be available for play in 100% Orange Juice immediately upon activating QP Shooting – Dangerous!! on Steam. She does not replace QP, but adds a separate playable character. QP Shooting – Dangerous!! is set for November 14 release, and preorders are now open at the [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/]Fruitbat Factory homepage[/url].

(Note: To play with the bonus character, you must own 100% Orange Juice.)
